CustomField.description: Sum of MEDDPICC scores. All 8 dimensions score 0-2 from their status picklist (Known but Unconfirmed = 1, Known and Confirmed = 2, else 0). Max 16.
CustomField.formula: CASE(TEXT(MEDDPICC_Pain_Status__c), "2 - Known and Confirmed", 2, "Known and Confirmed", 2, "1 - Known but Unconfirmed", 1, "Known but Unconfirmed", 1, 0) + CASE(TEXT(MEDDPICC_Decision_Criteria_Status__c), "2 - Known and Confirmed", 2, "Known and Confirmed", 2, "1 - Known but Unconfirmed", 1, "Known but Unconfirmed", 1, 0) + CASE(TEXT(MEDDPICC_Metrics_Status__c), "2 - Known and Confirmed", 2, "Known and Confirmed", 2, "1 - Known but Unconfirmed", 1, "Known but Unconfirmed", 1, 0) + CASE(TEXT(MEDDPICC_Economic_Buyer_Status__c), "2 - Known and Confirmed", 2, "Known and Confirmed", 2, "1 - Known but Unconfirmed", 1, "Known but Unconfirmed", 1, 0) + CASE(TEXT(MEDDPICC_Decision_Process_Status__c), "2 - Known and Confirmed", 2, "Known and Confirmed", 2, "1 - Known but Unconfirmed", 1, "Known but Unconfirmed", 1, 0) + CASE(TEXT(MEDDPICC_Paper_Process_Status__c), "2 - Known and Confirmed", 2, "Known and Confirmed", 2, "1 - Known but Unconfirmed", 1, "Known but Unconfirmed", 1, 0) + CASE(TEXT(MEDDPICC_Champion_Status__c), "2 - Known and Confirmed", 2, "Known and Confirmed", 2, "1 - Known but Unconfirmed", 1, "Known but Unconfirmed", 1, 0) + CASE(TEXT(MEDDPICC_Competition_Status__c), "2 - Known and Confirmed", 2, "Known and Confirmed", 2, "1 - Known but Unconfirmed", 1, "Known but Unconfirmed", 1, 0)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Auto-calculated. Each of the 8 MEDDPICC dimensions scores 0-2 from its status: Known but Unconfirmed = 1, Known and Confirmed = 2. Maximum score is 16. Read-only.
CustomField.label: MEDDPICC Score
